==Location==
We are using [[Wikipedia:Wikipedia:Subpages|subpages]] of each book, linked from the Chapter Index box on the right of each [[:Category:Series books|book page]].

==Using templates and substitution==
See [[Help:Book templates]]

==Layout==
===Field descriptions===
*book= a number from 1-12 or "p1" for New Spring.
*ewot= and are for linking to their chapter summaries (if you know of similar websites with detailed summaries, please bring them up at [[project talk:{{PAGENAME}}]])
*title= The chapter's title.
*setting= Where the events take place

===Skeleton===
Copy paste this whenever you start a new summary.  An example footnote is included (for more information, see [[Wikipedia:Wikipedia:Footnotes|Footnotes]])

<pre><nowiki>
{{quote | It is suggested that you place a humorous, interesting, or otherwise significant quote from the chapter here.
|[[whoever said it]] (blank if not quoting a character)
}}

{{summary | book=X | ewot=chXX | tarvalon=XXX
|chapter=INSERT CHAPTER NUMBER
|title=INSERT CHAPTER TITLE
|icon=INSERT ICON NAME
|setting=[[INSERT PLACE NAME]]
}}

==Summary==
:{{pov|[[Rand al'Thor | Rand]]}}

PLOT SYNOPSIS STARTS HERE {{ref|This is an example footnote.}}
MORE PLOT SYNOPSIS

:{{setting|[[INSERT PLACE NAME]]}}

-->

</nowiki></pre>

If a chapter has no information pertaining to a given heading or subheading, such as "Sayings", indicate this with an indented "None." Example:
<pre><nowiki>
===Sayings===
:None.
</nowiki></pre>

===Linking===
Anything unique to '''''The Wheel of Time''''' deserves to be linked the first time it is referenced in an article.

====First appearances====
The first time we meet a character, the plot summary should link to their full name, for example:
 <nowiki>[[Nynaeve al'Meara]], the village Wisdom comes by and reprimands Mat for his loose talk about Bili Congar.</nowiki>
 <nowiki>[[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan]]</nowiki>

==== Later appearances ====
Future appearances in other chapters should be listed using one of the following syntaxes:

=====Common names=====
<code><nowiki>[[</nowiki>'''''article name'''''|'''''name used most frequently in the chapter''''']]</code>
In general, this is prefered if it is the significantly most common way to refer to something.
'''Examples:'''
 <nowiki>[[</nowiki>Matrim Cauthon|Mat]]
 <nowiki>[[</nowiki>Thomdril Merrilin|Thom]]

=====Using redirects=====
Most of the main character names should have redirects, so it is also acceptable to use those:
 <nowiki>[[Mat]]</nowiki>
 <nowiki>[[Thom]]</nowiki>

=====Titles and aliases=====
<code><nowiki>[[</nowiki>'''''article name''''']] - as '''''some special name used in the chapter'''''</code>
In general, this is for lesser used titles, aliases, and categorizations.
 The <nowiki>[[Dark One]] - as ''Great Lord''</nowiki>
 <nowiki>[[Thomdril Merilin|Thom]] - as ''the [[gleeman]]''</nowiki>

====Quantifiers====
These should be used often if applicable, especially in lists of occurances at the bottom of an article, but they should go ''before'' links, not ''in'' them 

''things'' or ''categories'' there are many of but of which only one appears in the chapter should be prefixed accordingly. '''Examples''':
 A <nowiki>[[Myrddraal]] - as a ''Fade''</nowiki>
 An <nowiki>[[Aiel]]</nowiki>
 A few <nowiki>[[Tarabon|Taraboner]] commoners</nowiki>
 Some <nowiki>[[Trollocs]]</nowiki>
 3 <nowiki>''[[grolm]]''</nowiki>

==Quotations==
'''Proposal:''' Each individual summary ''should'' contain at least one quotation at the top of the page. Quotes of the prose (as opposed to dialogue, internal monologues, and character POVs), can be attributed to Robert Jordan directly. To quote a character, the source can be a link to that character's page. But the source can also be more descriptive, or attributed to Robert Jordan directly, or omitted entirely if it's just a direct quote from that particular chapter.

 <nowiki>{{quote|text to quote|source}}</nowiki>
:
 <nowiki>[[firstname lastname]]</nowiki>
Be sure to include the "|" after the text being quoted.  

Some examples:

 <nowiki>{{quote|The Wheel of Time turns, and Ages come and pass, leaving memories that become legend. Legend fades to myth, and even myth is long forgotten when the Age that gave it birth comes again.|[[Robert Jordan]]{{ref/book|1|1}}{{ref/book|11|1}}}}</nowiki>
{{quote|The Wheel of Time turns, and Ages come and pass, leaving memories that become legend. Legend fades to myth, and even myth is long forgotten when the Age that gave it birth comes again.|[[Robert Jordan]]{{ref/book|1|1}}{{ref/book|11|1}}}}

 <nowiki>{{quote|Rand screamed. He felt as if he were collapsing like an empty sack, as if he were being turned inside out. The pain in his side, the wound taken at Falme, was almost welcome, something to hang onto, a reminder of life.. His hand closed convulsively. On Callandor's hilt.|{{3|55}}}}</nowiki>
{{quote|Rand screamed. He felt as if he were collapsing like an empty sack, as if he were being turned inside out. The pain in his side, the wound taken at Falme, was almost welcome, something to hang onto, a reminder of life.. His hand closed convulsively. On Callandor's hilt.|{{3|55}}}}
